claim_boundary: This matrix classifies observed evidence; it does not render, run native/RLR, or authorize dataset admission, and it never accepts a caller-written status.

support_protocols.support_surface: measured support surface plus a planner transform; used for assets whose resting pose was measured against a tabletop, wall or ceiling
support_protocols.ground_contact: registered floor attachment plus a retained native trajectory whose root sits on that world's measured floor; used for articulated sources

api.world_compatibility: an asset passes only when the dimensions that name a world share one
api.remaining_work: every asset row carries remaining_work, and the matrix carries work_buckets; both are derived from the current dimension states, so a consumer reads the schedule from the matrix and never from a copied coordination marker

inputs.registry: runtime source asset registry (path or mapping) with assets[]
inputs.source_type_inventory: fine-type inventory with types{} and the expected counts
inputs.asset_worklist: acceptance worklist rows keyed by type
inputs.config: production spec whose episodes bind assets to instances
inputs.geometry_measurements: one or more catalogs carrying asset_visual_geometry_measurements
inputs.support_catalogs: one or more support surface catalogs carrying layout.support_surfaces
inputs.floor_reference_m: measured room floor height for the placement check
inputs.floor_references: {room_id: {floor_height_m, source}} measured floors, for ground-contact assets
inputs.world_room_map: {world_id: room_id} so a retained observation can find its room's floor
inputs.world_floor_planes: {world_id or room_id: {visual_floor_plane_y_m, source}} the drawn floor a foot contact is judged against; a navmesh snap height is not accepted in its place
inputs.placement_intents: {asset_id: {support_kind, candidate_surface_ids, source}} an episode's declared placement intent; it selects candidates and is verified, and is never recorded as a measurement
inputs.floor_contact_tolerance_m: how far a native root may sit from the measured floor and still count as contact
inputs.media_probe: callable(path) -> {exists, frames, channels, sample_rate_hz, peak_abs, finite}
inputs.provider_evidence: {asset_id: {geometry_measurement, placement_rows[], retained_observations[]}} -- the override provider hook; observations only, verdict keys are refused

api.claim_boundary: a provider may only widen what is observed; the module derives every dimension status itself and never accepts a caller-written verdict

world_association.navigation_layer_boundary: a resolved association gives the navmesh floor the run navigated on. It does not give the visual floor of that level, which needs a retained depth and semantic capture of the same world; every world here reports that as not_run.

p09_visible_binding_hm3d_fresh_g03.method: median height of the measured visual floor points under the sole contact centroid, per frame

world_association.world_id_normalisation: world ids come from the retained observation's own world_id and from the capture the foot readback names; a group_id is never used as a world id
